### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem you are trying to solve (e.g. "I am always frustrated when trying to parse symbols from Kotlin files...").

### Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it adheres to RepoPilot's zero-budget, evidence-grounded philosophy.

### Evidence & Implementation Details
- Which domain packages would be affected? (`@repopilot/core`, `@repopilot/indexer`, `@repopilot/analysis`, etc.)
- Are there existing open-source libraries or deterministic algorithms that can support this?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
